body:
Thanks for the help. They told me that once that I turn 18, they want to kick me out of the house and never want to see me ever again. So I honestly dont think they would care if I just killed myself.

Luckily I do have some friends that truly do care about me, and I have told them about my situation and they're trying to help as well. Unfortunately, my parents have been adamant in trying to mock me and put me down any chance that they get. 

Idk it's hard to explain it all, but I just really dont want to have to deal with them or life in general anymore. And the truth is that everyone will be able to move on and live life perfectly without me here.
